question_text: In a high-frequency trading system, batch processing cycles are optimized using integer parameters. A processing algorithm executes when the cycle index $n$, a positive integer, satisfies all three conditions: $n$ leaves a remainder of $2$ when divided by $5$, $n$ leaves a remainder of $4$ when divided by $7$, and $n$ is divisible by $3$. If $n$ is the smallest positive integer greater than $200$ that satisfies these conditions, what is the remainder when $n$ is divided by $11$?
